name: Member's Mark Four Cheese Italian Tortelloni (Refrigerated 2-Pack)
whyItWorks: Tender fresh egg pasta filled with smooth ricotta, mascarpone, parmesan, and romano cheeses. Boils in just 4 minutes to create an ultra-soft, low-roughage comfort meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil gently until tender. Toss with a light drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and salt rather than heavy cream sauces.
